info.name: Course Enrollment API
info.description:
Runs the whole workflow end to end: login, browse, create a course, enroll, approve, full-course and security checks.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner). Start the backend first: ./mvnw spring-boot:run

exec: pm.test("Contains the new request", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(e => e.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("enrollmentId"))).to.be.true);

item.name: Lower capacity to the approved count (allowed)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman Demo {{runId}}",
  "description": "Created from the Postman collection",
  "category": "Testing",
  "imageUrl": "",
  "capacity": 1,
  "active": true
}

exec: pm.test("Course is now full", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.approvedCount).to.eql(c.capacity); });
